lines.text: So what are you coming in with today?
I'm coming in with pain in my left knee when I go down stairs.
It started after netball three weeks ago.
Hi, sorry I'm late, the parking was a nightmare.
Hi, come on in and grab a seat.
Let me have a look at that left knee now.
There's reduced range into bending and it's pretty tight through the quads.
I'll send you some exercises for the quads to start with.
